name: Header Space Between Search
summary: Page header section on a white surface, the copy on the left and the actions on the right (stacked under 992px), with a search field. Rebuilt in DS tokens and the DS button, input and tab styles; framework-free. Layout idea from a public header-section gallery, no third-party code or assets.
highlights: White surface: black headline, secondary-grey body, Vivid Pink eyebrow, DS primary and default button styles
Layout: the copy on the left and the actions on the right (stacked under 992px); copy at most 768px inside a 1280px container; stacks and tightens in its own container width at 991px and 479px
Headline, supporting text, labels, links and the optional action are per-page content
Reads only shared --aha-* tokens: no new colours, radii or raw sizes; controls are 40px high
